comments.body: For your information, this testcase is reduced from a valid C program containing `_BitInt`. Maybe the bitwidth is changed after reduction. Let me know if anyone needs an unreduced C testcase.

issue.title: [RISCV][CostModel] opt crashed and triggered assertion `(SrcLT.first == 1) && (DstLT.first == 1) && "Illegal type"'

patch:
commit 3637f66b4d819c1cef6a3b58466fc8b1f983cfe0
Author: Elvis Wang <elvis.wang@sifive.com>
Date:   Mon Nov 10 17:01:43 2025 +0800

    [RISCV][TTI] Fix crash of non-built-in vector type cost quering. (#167258)
    
    For the non-built-in vector type, the RISCV cost model cannot handle
    this properly.
    So fall back to the BasicTTI for this situation.
    
    Fixes: #166732

diff --git a/llvm/lib/Target/RISCV/RISCVTargetTransformInfo.cpp b/llvm/lib/Target/RISCV/RISCVTargetTransformInfo.cpp
index 332433b4e530..3d8eb4097604 100644
--- a/llvm/lib/Target/RISCV/RISCVTargetTransformInfo.cpp
+++ b/llvm/lib/Target/RISCV/RISCVTargetTransformInfo.cpp
@@ -1683,7 +1683,8 @@ InstructionCost RISCVTTIImpl::getCastInstrCost(unsigned Opcode, Type *Dst,
       !TypeSize::isKnownLE(DL.getTypeSizeInBits(Src),
                            SrcLT.second.getSizeInBits()) ||
       !TypeSize::isKnownLE(DL.getTypeSizeInBits(Dst),
-                           DstLT.second.getSizeInBits()))
+                           DstLT.second.getSizeInBits()) ||
+      SrcLT.first > 1 || DstLT.first > 1)
     return BaseT::getCastInstrCost(Opcode, Dst, Src, CCH, CostKind, I);
 
   // The split cost is handled by the base getCastInstrCost

tests.test_body:
define void @legalization_crash() {
  %1 = bitcast <24 x i8> undef to <192 x i1>
  %2 = trunc <192 x i8> undef to <192 x i1>
  %3 = zext <192 x i1> undef to <192 x i8>
  %4 = sext <192 x i1> undef to <192 x i8>
  %5 = sitofp <192 x i1> undef to <192 x float>
  %6 = uitofp <192 x i1> undef to <192 x float>
  %7 = fptosi <192 x float> undef to <192 x i1>
  %8 = fptoui <192 x float> undef to <192 x i1>
  ret void
}
